nodes.rationale: Python STT library for assistants/dictation needing VAD, fast transcription, realtime text, wake words with few lines of code.

nodes.label: CPU Nemotron-live / Parakeet-final profile
nodes.rationale: Nemotron processes only new frames for replaceable realtime text; Parakeet refines the complete turn once at finalization. Better CPU streaming than repeatedly retranscribing a growing buffer while keeping a high-quality final.

nodes.label: Live-flush Preview (--preview-live-flush)
nodes.rationale: At a pause the streaming model decodes unfinalized audio on a copy of its state so the live stream continues; Preview arrives in tens of ms (48 ms measured) instead of waiting for full re-decode.

nodes.label: Live-flush Preview protocol
nodes.rationale: Live lane snapshot flush answers preview (status flush); full-model decode follows as previewRecord; optional previewRefined; falls back if flush empty/fails/>0.5 s.

nodes.label: Lazy-loaded Transcription Engine Factory

nodes.label: Separate realtime_transcription_engine

nodes.label: Fast Engine Contract Tests
nodes.rationale: New engines should first cover factory selection, missing dependency errors, parameter mapping, audio normalization and result conversion.

nodes.label: Streaming session lifecycle
nodes.rationale: create_streaming_session -> accept_audio(new samples) -> decode/get_result -> finish -> close; avoids retranscribing the whole buffer.

nodes.label: Pinned Nemotron/Parakeet model manifests
nodes.rationale: Package ships manifests and install tooling, not weights, which remain externally licensed.

nodes.label: Realtime punctuation splitting
nodes.rationale: Opt-in via realtime_punctuation_split_marks; 'sentence' is production mode; requires word timestamps (faster_whisper only).

nodes.label: Ultrafast lane sticky merge
nodes.rationale: realtime_model_type stays authoritative; second model appends <=5 words after safe 4/3-word anchor; accepted fast words sticky within a generation; final never consumes merged text.

nodes.label: Lazy optional dependency imports
nodes.rationale: Importing RealtimeSTT must not import every backend.

nodes.label: User-owned engine path
nodes.rationale: Preferred unless contributing; pass object/callable to transcription_executor.

nodes.label: Dual realtime / ultrafast lane
nodes.rationale: Ultrafast text stays private until safely aligned to accurate text; missing/conflicting anchor never publishes raw ultrafast words.

nodes.label: Kroko/Banafo kroko_onnx integration
nodes.rationale: Fast, accurate local streaming ASR; Community models for testing, commercial models for production.

nodes.label: Advisory previewMode early_rms
nodes.rationale: Appends 25 ms zero PCM to first and only decode and publishes empty result immediately to reduce latency.

nodes.label: Late full-turn correction (--allow-late-final-transcription)
nodes.rationale: Authenticated HTTP operation=late_full_turn_correction, capped at 30 s.

nodes.label: Preview-only mode (--preview-only)
nodes.rationale: Disables complete-turn Final ASR; complete buffered turn transcribed at Preview time; live text is diagnostic only.

nodes.label: Correlated Resume command and resume_ack barrier
nodes.norm_label: correlated resume command and resume_ack barrier
nodes.rationale: resume_ack is an ordered wire barrier; resumeEpoch lets clients discard delayed live revisions; cancels queued older Preview snapshots.

nodes.label: Request-scoped cancellable transcription
nodes.rationale: Superseded transcribe.cpp Preview inference cancellable during native decode without reloading the resident model.

nodes.label: Miep (client application)
nodes.rationale: Decides when an early browser RMS pause is advisory; maintains 64 ms continuation hysteresis outside RealtimeSTT.

nodes.label: omnilingual_asr engine (Meta Omnilingual ASR)

nodes.norm_label: resident kroko fp32 request cancellation patch
nodes.rationale: cancel ID terminates only that job's ONNX RunOptions; resident model stays loaded; old IDs cannot cancel successors.

nodes.label: Bounded, coalesced Preview admission
nodes.rationale: One native dispatch lane retains only the latest pending snapshot while older inference runs; superseded snapshots retired so stale work cannot delay newer ones.

nodes.label: Final-transcription A/B results
nodes.rationale: Identical WER 0.0436; single-client parity; 4 clients +7.5% throughput, -33.2% p95 latency.

nodes.label: Two-model CPU server memory result

nodes.label: Windows Parakeet empty-final limitation
nodes.rationale: Native Windows is a development target; intermittent empty Parakeet finals on cumulative-recovery audio; use faster_whisper there.

nodes.label: REALTIMESTT_SERVER_BEARER_TOKEN

nodes.label: Tail-anchored Preview (--preview-input-mode tail)
nodes.rationale: Decodes only newest audio and joins to recognized text so cost no longer grows with turn length (149 ms vs ~710 ms full-turn).

nodes.label: Capacity and memory sizing
nodes.rationale: Size from measured resident set plus buffers, not archive sizes; queues bounded; backpressure is a protocol outcome.

nodes.label: Reverse-proxy TLS deployment
nodes.rationale: Keep server on loopback; proxy owns certificates and public TLS, keeping ASR process off the network. Non-loopback binds require bearer token + TLS files.

nodes.label: Tail-anchored Preview decode
nodes.rationale: Decodes audio after anchor plus overlap (default 1.5 s, >=4 words) and splices at a word match; falls back to full turn when splice unproven or skip < 0.5 s.

nodes.label: Two-event terminal reserve / close 1013 backpressure
nodes.rationale: Coalesce stale partials without sequence gaps; preserve final/completion; close slow clients instead of unbounded queues.

nodes.rationale: ONNX Runtime worker pools spinning compete for cores; disabling spinning cut 5s median from 662ms to 107ms; official 1.13.8 beat custom 1.13.4 build. Thread count is host-specific, not portable.

nodes.label: use_main_model_for_realtime (shared model lane)
nodes.rationale: Saves memory but realtime and final work contend for the same model, reducing responsiveness.

nodes.label: 40-second audio limit guard
nodes.rationale: Non-streaming pipeline requires audio shorter than 40s; default guard 39.9s.

nodes.label: Shared final/realtime inference lanes
nodes.rationale: Heavy ASR engines shared across sessions instead of one model per browser; each session keeps lightweight recorder/VAD state feeding a shared scheduler.

nodes.label: Official sherpa-ONNX 1.13.8 spinning-disabled tuning
nodes.rationale: Seven threads with CPU worker spinning disabled beat the earlier custom build (107.2 vs 113.3 ms) using official wheels, no custom native build.

nodes.label: kroko_fp32 engine (English-only, offline)

nodes.label: --stdio-server protocol v1
nodes.rationale: One resident process per worker keeps model/ONNX sessions loaded; cancellation kills the process and next request restarts it.

nodes.label: transcribe_cpp engine (low-latency offline Parakeet)
nodes.rationale: Calls serialized by engine lock since transcribe.cpp 0.x permits one in-flight run per model; CUDA selection exact, no silent CPU fallback; engine never mutates process-wide env.

nodes.label: Fast final-transcription profile (Flash off, n_threads=7, ~27ms)

nodes.label: QwenCpuEngine

nodes.label: QwenEngine
nodes.rationale: Recommended engine on NVIDIA Windows/Linux: high-quality multilingual synthesis, x-vector and ICL cloning, frame streaming before utterance completion, stop() reaches native loop leaving model context reusable.

nodes.label: realtimetts-qwen-native package
nodes.rationale: RealtimeTTS-owned PyPI name packaging MIT upstream qwentts-cpp-python binding; GPU extra pins 0.2.0 with C ABI 5, CUDA 12.8 wheels; no sdist fallback.

nodes.label: realtimetts-qwen-server (OpenAI-compatible HTTP/WebSocket server)
nodes.rationale: Wraps the same in-process engine; single Uvicorn worker since a second would duplicate VRAM; loopback by default, bearer-key auth, wildcard CORS rejected; concurrency one because a model context serializes synthesis.

nodes.label: Qwen voice cache (.spk/.rvq)
nodes.rationale: Keyed by reference audio SHA-256, normalized text, model/quant, ABI and binding version; atomic commit with metadata last.

nodes.label: Emotional Qwen showcase

nodes.label: clamp_fp16 option
nodes.rationale: FP16-overflow guard for pre-Ampere GPUs; default True; ~1.8% overhead on RTX 2080 SUPER.

nodes.label: Full ICL cloning
nodes.rationale: Uses .spk and .rvq conditioning plus exact reference transcript; preserves reference voice more closely but adds request-time reference-context processing.

nodes.label: Automatic language and reference routing (fastText)
nodes.rationale: Interpolated top-1/top-2 margin between scores 0.50-0.67 avoids hard confidence buckets while keeping weak predictions out of routing.

nodes.label: Leading-silence trimming and startup buffer
nodes.rationale: Trims to first audible 5 ms window with 15 ms pre-roll and fade, accumulates 160 ms audio before first chunk; trades ~34.5 ms transport latency for speech audible ~25.5 ms sooner and prevents underruns.

nodes.label: Generated-onset suppression profile (qwen3_tts_12hz_0_6b_base_q8_v1)
nodes.rationale: Checkpoint-specific, hash-verified; suppresses silent c0 candidates in first three codec frames for x-vector voices only; distinct from downstream PCM trim.

nodes.label: X-vector (speaker-only) cloning
nodes.rationale: Uses only speaker embedding; useful when target language differs from reference.

nodes.label: Conditional quiet-onset recovery (removed in 0.8.10)
nodes.rationale: Retried once with CPU v2 profile after 240 ms quiet PCM; reduced p95 first speech 535->409 ms, but removed in 0.8.10 because restarting synthesis can interrupt streaming playback. Blanket c0 masks 1221/2042 rejected for extra syllables.

nodes.label: CPU codec decoder overlap (cpu_codec_threads)
nodes.rationale: Separate generation and decoder pools raised throughput 30-35% on i9-13900KF; cpu_codec_threads=0 keeps serial decoding.

nodes.label: CPU fused attention
nodes.rationale: Reduced RTF ~6.4% on Ryzen 3900X; not bit-identical to default path.

nodes.label: windows-3900x preset
nodes.rationale: Machine-specific masks 0x555/0x555000 and AboveNormal priority; not portable to other topologies.

nodes.label: TestPyPI-first release policy
nodes.rationale: PyPI only after fresh-install and real-speech acceptance; uploaded filenames cannot be replaced so failures become new rc candidates; editable installs would mask missing packaged files.

nodes.label: Signed attestation release flow
nodes.rationale: Promote exact artifact exercised by target runtime; guard checks hashes and git status, evidence must be <30 minutes old.

nodes.label: stt-install-sherpa-models installer
nodes.rationale: Engine init never downloads weights; installer verifies archive SHA-256, extracts atomically, resumes, and reuses offline caches.
